q_45367.question_text: What will be NVIDIA's forward guidance in its Q2 FY2027 earnings release? (Revenue)
q_45367.reasoning:
# Analysis

## (a) Time left until resolution

Today is August 23, 2026. NVIDIA is set to release Q2 FY2027 earnings on Wednesday, August 26, 2026. That's approximately **3 days** until the earnings release and guidance announcement.

## (b) Most likely outcome and why

NVIDIA has already issued explicit forward guidance for Q2 FY2027: **$91.0 billion ±2%**, which translates to a range of **$89.18 billion to $92.82 billion**.

With only 3 days until the earnings release, this guidance is the most reliable basis for forecasting what NVIDIA will announce. Companies rarely materially revise guidance between the previous quarter's earnings call and the current quarter's announcement without major intervening events.

**The most likely outcome is that NVIDIA will reaffirm or slightly adjust its $91.0 billion guidance**, keeping the forecast within or very close to the $89.2-$92.8 billion range they've already provided.

Supporting factors:
- NVIDIA explicitly guided to $91.0B ±2% on May 20, 2026
- Wall Street consensus ($91.9B) is very close to the midpoint of this guidance
- NVIDIA historically beats guidance (top end exceeded by ~$2B in Q1 FY2027), but this is usually a small beat, not a massive miss or upside surprise
- Only 3 days remain—insufficient time for material business changes
- The guidance explicitly factors in zero Data Center revenue from China, so geopolitical assumptions are already embedded

## (c) What would push the value lower?

- **Weaker-than-expected demand signals** in the final days of the quarter
- **Supply chain disruptions** or manufacturing delays
- **Geopolitical escalation** affecting China export restrictions (though already assumed at zero)
- **Major customer cancellations or deferrals** announced in the last 72 hours
- **Macro deterioration** (unlikely to be material in 3 days)

However, these are unlikely with so little time remaining and no indication of such issues in the research.

## (d) What would push the value higher?

- **Better-than-expected demand momentum** (as seen in Q1, when NVIDIA beat by ~$2B)
- **Higher-than-expected AI/Data Center bookings** in the final stretch of the quarter
- **Upside from enterprise or cloud customer orders**
- **Benign competitive dynamics** allowing price maintenance or volume growth

Given NVIDIA's track record of beating estimates by 3-6% on EPS (and Q1 revenue beat of ~$2B), there's a material probability of modest upside guidance relative to the $89.2-$92.8B range, pushing toward $93-95B territory.

## (e) Base rate or historical reference values

From the research provided:
- **Q1 FY2027 actual revenue: $81.6 billion** (exceeded top end of previous guidance by ~$2 billion)
- **Q2 FY2027 guidance already issued: $91.0B ±2% ($89.18B–$92.82B ceiling)**
- **Wall Street consensus: $91.9 billion** (within guidance range, modestly above midpoint)
- **Analyst average (LSEG): $86.84 billion** (below NVIDIA's guidance, suggesting NVIDIA has higher conviction)
- **Historical EPS beats: 3-6% above consensus** in past four quarters

The guidance range itself is the most relevant base rate. NVIDIA's Q1 beat suggests a ~2% upside bias, but not dramatically so.

---

## Probability Distribution Reasoning

The range provided is 99.5–115.5 billion (with open bounds on both ends), which brackets forward guidance possibilities well beyond NVIDIA's explicit $89.2–$92.8B guidance range.

**Core scenario (70% probability):** NVIDIA reaffirms or slightly adjusts guidance to **$90.5–$92.5B**, keeping it within or just at the edges of the stated range.

**Upside scenario (20% probability):** Following the Q1 pattern and strong demand signals, guidance is raised to **$93–$95B** (modest beat to the midpoint).

**Downside scenario (5% probability):** Unexpected weakness leads to guidance below $89B.

**Tail scenarios (5% probability):** Extreme moves (>$95B or <$85B) seem unlikely with explicit prior guidance and only 3 days to earnings.

Given the explicit $91.0B guidance with ±2% range already in hand, the median should center on that midpoint with slight upside bias from historical beat patterns.

---

q_45367.research_text:
NVIDIA's forward guidance for Q2 FY2027 revenue, issued on May 20, 2026, predicts $91.0 billion, plus or minus 2% [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/), [sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000051/q1fy27pr.htm). This outlook explicitly assumes no Data Center compute revenue from China [fool.com](https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/08/19/nvidia-guided-to-usd91-billion-wall-street-penciled-in-usd92-billion/).

This guidance range has a ceiling near $92.8 billion and a floor near $89.2 billion [fool.com](https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/08/19/nvidia-guided-to-usd91-billion-wall-street-penciled-in-usd92-billion/). Wall Street analysts' average estimate for Q2 FY2027 revenue is approximately $91.9 billion, placing it within NVIDIA's guidance range [fool.com](https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/08/19/nvidia-guided-to-usd91-billion-wall-street-penciled-in-usd92-billion/). This figure is higher than the average estimate of $86.84 billion reported by LSEG [cnbc.com](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/05/20/nvidia-nvda-earnings-report-q1-2027.html).

In Q1 FY2027, NVIDIA reported record revenue of $81.6 billion, exceeding the top end of its previous guidance by about $2 billion [fool.com](https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/08/19/nvidia-guided-to-usd91-billion-wall-street-penciled-in-usd92-billion/). Historically, NVIDIA's adjusted earnings per share have topped analysts' estimates by 3% to 6% in the past four quarters [fool.com](https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/08/19/nvidia-guided-to-usd91-billion-wall-street-penciled-in-usd92-billion/). Morningstar analysts expect NVIDIA to generate "well over $300 billion of data center revenue in calendar 2026, which is effectively fiscal 2027" [morningstar.com](https://www.morningstar.com/stocks/going-into-earnings-is-nvidia-stock-buy-sell-or-fairly-valued-8). NVIDIA is set to release its Q2 FY2027 earnings on Wednesday, August 26 [morningstar.com](https://www.morningstar.com/stocks/going-into-earnings-is-nvidia-stock-buy-sell-or-fairly-valued-8).
